atoms.text:
Scotland can be divided into three regions. The Southern Uplands in the south, the Central Plain in the middle, and the Highlands in the north.
The Southern Uplands consist of small towns with lots of sheep farms. The Central Plain as well as the east coast are the most populated parts of Scotland. The Highlands are a mountainous region.

atoms.text: Besides the mountains, Scotland is also famous for its lakes. One of them is called “Loch Ness”. It attracts many tourists who believe that a large creature called Nessie lives in the lake.

atoms.a: Why do many tourists visit Loch Ness?
b: Cruise ships are going from Loch Ness to Scandinavia.
++They believe that a large creature lives in the lake.
There's a huge mall next to the lake where you can buy clothes.

instruction.text: Lies die Texte und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

atoms.text: Edinburgh is the capital city of Scotland. There are many historic buildings in the city. Edinburgh is also famous for its castle which is built on a rock.

hint.text: Nice to know: The rock was a vulcano millions of years ago.

atoms.text: Glasgow is another major city in Scotland, located west of Edinburgh. It's even bigger than Edinburgh. Glasgow is often associated with heavy industry. Nowadays, it is more famous for its cultural offerings.

b: The capital city of Scotland is the biggest city in the country.
++The capital city of Scotland is not the biggest city in the country.
++The capital city of Scotland is Edinburgh.
The capital city of Scotland is Glasgow.

atoms.text: Scotland is also famous for kilts and bagpipes. Kilts are knee-length, tartan skirts. It's a traditional piece of clothing that is worn by men. A bagpipe is an instrument that consists of at least two pipes and a bag.

trainers.finishSound: Dear Sophie, I'm on holiday in Scotland right now. I'm staying in Glasgow which is even bigger than the capital city Edinburgh. The architecture is really modern. It reminds me a little of central London. I'll go on a trip to the Highlands tomorrow. Maybe I'll be able to snap a picture of Nessie the Loch Ness Monster. Hope to hear from you soon! Yours, Oliver.
